entry.name: rnbo_routepass
entry.digest: Select outlet based on input matching.
entry.description: Tries to match a message's first argument to the routepass object's own arguments. Unlike the route object, routepass does not strip off the matched portion of the message. The rightmost outlet passes any message that matched no other choice, so you may gang route objects to get more choices.
